description: Returns dashboard summary: latest created workouts with stats and ready-to-download items. Use when the user asks about dashboard, recent workouts, or content ready for download.

days_back.description: How many days back to look for ready downloads, 1 to 365. Defaults to 30.

include_ai_clips.description: Include AI clips ready to download. Defaults to true.

include_workouts.description: Include workouts ready to download. Defaults to true.

include_youtube_stats.description: Include YouTube stats on the latest workouts. Defaults to true.

limit.description: How many items to fetch per section, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

name: get_dashboard_summary
title: Get dashboard summary
